UT2004 is Direct3D-only and .124 runs the experimental vcr-kmd driver, so it was not launched. It needs a supervised session.
Capability gate: 701 MHz against the 1000 MHz floor, and 255 MB RAM against 256. No shortcut is deployed. Lowering the floor is a pending user decision.
Win7 32-bit with a GTX 1650 on the Standard VGA stub has no 3D driver, and UT2004 needs D3DDrv.
P166 with Voodoo 2 on Win98. The operator override says 'not wanted on .243', the title is not installed, and the box is far below UT2004's floor.

summary: UT2004: all 6 applicable boxes (.110 .123 .143 .171 .184 .240) were in one DM-Rankin match on the dev host's ut2004-server at the same time. The 8-minute hold was met: at 17:52 every box was still connected, with no Close TcpipConnection line and 384-512 packets per box in 12 s. .143 did not repeat its 2026-10-13 drop. .124 is BLOCKED (D3D on vcr-kmd). .133, .186 and .243 are NA. The game was closed gracefully on all six boxes.
issues: The 17:48 frames of .143, .184 and .240 show the map with no HUD (spectating or dead-cam?), while .110, .123 and .171 show the full HUD. The roster still lists all six as players (not spectators) and every box sends full-rate packets, so they count as in the game. A visible HUD on those three was not re-confirmed.
server.log has a second 'New Player' line for Fleet171, Fleet240 and Fleet184, from the spectator-to-player spawn clicks. No disconnect lines.
